jobs.company: South Carolina Department of Public Health
jobs.summary: Building and maintaining enterprise application functionality, reporting and data validation automation across public health technology systems.
highlights: ~40% improvement in query execution time across reported SQL Server optimization efforts.
Python validation workflows across 12,000+ managed IT resources, eliminating ~15 hours of manual work per week.
responsibilities: Develop and maintain enterprise application functionality using **C#, ASP.NET, and .NET Core**, supporting application enhancements, backend functionality, and integration requirements across public health technology systems.

Develop and maintain frontend application components using **Angular and TypeScript**, integrating REST APIs to exchange data between frontend applications and backend services while validating request and response behavior.

Design, develop, and optimize **Microsoft SQL Server queries and stored procedures** to retrieve, validate, and process relational data, achieving approximately **40% improvement in query execution time** across reported optimization efforts.

Support healthcare application security and data protection requirements by applying **HIPAA compliance practices**, reviewing application access, troubleshooting authentication and authorization issues, and investigating data accessibility concerns.

Develop **Python automation and data validation workflows** to reconcile enterprise records, identify missing attributes, and detect configuration discrepancies across an environment supporting **12,000+ managed IT resources, eliminating approximately 15 hours of manual work per week**.

Develop and maintain application reporting solutions using **SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS)**, supporting structured data retrieval, reporting requirements, and operational visibility for technical stakeholders.

Collaborate with database administrators, application developers, and business stakeholders through **Agile/Scrum methodologies** to analyze requirements, validate application changes, troubleshoot production incidents, and maintain technical documentation.
jobs.tools: C#, ASP.NET, .NET Core, Angular, TypeScript, SQL Server, SSRS, Python, REST APIs, HIPAA

jobs.summary: Python backend services, AWS integration workflows, secure authentication and production monitoring for cloud-hosted applications.
highlights: Release verification cut from ~40 minutes to under 10 minutes, a 75%+ efficiency gain.
Kept cloud-hosted applications reliable through a reported 10x increase in traffic.
responsibilities: Developed and maintained **Python-based backend services and AWS application integration workflows, supporting cloud-hosted applications and improving operational reliability during periods of increased application demand, including a reported 10x increase in traffic**.

Built automated application health checks and deployment validation scripts using **Python, reducing release verification time from approximately 40 minutes to under 10 minutes and improving deployment efficiency by more than 75%**.

Developed and troubleshot **REST API and webhook integrations, analyzing HTTP requests, response payloads, authentication headers, and application logs using Postman and curl** to resolve communication failures between connected services.

Investigated application defects and backend processing failures by analyzing service logs, request-response behavior, and integration dependencies, identifying root causes and coordinating corrective actions to restore application functionality.

Implemented secure application authentication and authorization workflows using **OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), and SAML**, troubleshooting token validation, access configurations, and authentication failures across integrated applications.

Implemented application monitoring and production troubleshooting workflows using **Grafana and Sentry**, identifying recurring application exceptions, analyzing performance issues, and documenting remediation recommendations for engineering stakeholders.
jobs.tools: Python, AWS, REST APIs, Webhooks, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, Grafana, Sentry, Postman, curl

jobs.summary: Backend components, APIs and database operations for distributed systems serving more than 50,000 concurrent users.
highlights: Investigated application and database issues in distributed systems serving 50,000+ concurrent users.
responsibilities: Developed and maintained backend application components using **Java, Python, and SQL**, implementing business logic, data-processing workflows, and application functionality to support business-critical operations.

Designed and integrated **REST APIs and web services** to facilitate communication between application components and external systems, validating request and response payloads and resolving integration failures.

Developed and optimized **MySQL queries and relational database operations** to retrieve, validate, and manage application data, investigate production data inconsistencies, and improve database performance.

Investigated complex application and database issues affecting distributed systems serving more than **50,000 concurrent users**, analyzing application logs, database behavior, and system metrics to identify root causes and implement corrective solutions.

Implemented **Python and Shell automation scripts** for application maintenance, data validation, recurring operational tasks, and incident investigation, reducing repetitive troubleshooting activities and improving operational efficiency.

Participated in the **Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)**, collaborating with development and support teams on requirements analysis, application testing, defect reproduction, debugging, release validation, and production issue resolution.
jobs.tools: Java, Python, SQL, MySQL, REST APIs, Shell, SDLC
